name: Blue Professional
summary: An investment-research briefing that moves: warm cream, one saturated cobalt for every numeral and chart, near-black headlines in Space Grotesk, soft cobalt-tinted rounded cards with no shadows, and measured slides along one axis with a progress bar keeping count.

palette.use: card-bg: cobalt at 4% on the cream (the source's rgba, flattened)
tertiary text, the light that passes straight through
cobalt, the ONLY accent: eyebrows, every numeral, the CTA, chart fills, the progress bar, the 4 px highlight rule
accent-light: cobalt at 8%: tag pills, bar tracks, highlight blocks (the source's rgba, flattened)
only as inline up-change chip text
only as inline down-change chip text

type.case: sentence case; uppercase only on the eyebrow
type.emphasis: a tinted highlight block with a 4 px cobalt left rule; never italic, never a cobalt headline

banned: a second accent colour; cobalt headlines
drop shadows on content; opaque cobalt borders
square corners (except the progress bar); font substitutes; uppercase body; italic
green or red as general accents: they're inline chip text only
heavier borders to fill space; edge-to-edge headlines
KPI grids and three cards in a row: one metric per frame, cards stack
bounce, overshoot, spinning, any move off the one horizontal axis except the panel
more than one solid cobalt surface per frame

sources.what: HyperFrames frame preset Blue Professional: palette, faces, type ramp, elements, frames, banned list, caption skin
